documents.text:
Hello, everyone!

The release of Palworld's first major update, the Sakurajima Update, has been scheduled for Thursday, June 27, 2024.

In addition to the release date, the latest trailer has been released.

[previewyoutube=fKzLdPZr2Fk;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the new island of Sakurajima, the update is full of new content and mechanics! So much so that we couldn't fit them all in the trailer!

We hope you are looking forward to it!

Palworld Development Team

documents.label: Palworld · patch_note · 2024-11-28 · A major update for Palworld will be released in December!
documents.text:
Hello everyone!

･ About the Major Update

A major update will be released in December!

The new mysterious island is the largest and harshest in Palworld's history. The island is about six times the size of Sakurajima, which was added in the last major update! Powerful tower bosses and many vicious new species of Pals lurk here.

A large amount of new content will also be added.

･ Collaboration with Terraria!

Collaboration with the adventure game Terraria, which has sold over 60 million copies worldwide, has been confirmed for 2025! Stay tuned for further updates!

Thank you for your continued support of Palworld.

Palworld Development Team

answer: The Sakurajima update (June 27, 2024) did not significantly alter player reviews of Palworld. Review volume decreased after the update (average reviews per month: 2,730.7 before vs. 259.2 after; p-value=0.2313 for trend), but the positive share remained stable (0.94 before vs. 0.9344 after; difference: -0.0056, p-value=0.4092) [T1]. Sentiment analysis of a sample showed no significant change in overall positivity (0.9591 before vs. 0.9567 after; p-value=0.9453) [T2]. While some aspects like "story" showed a statistically significant increase in complaint share (p=0.0151), the overall review sentiment did not shift meaningfully. The data does not show a statistically significant change in review trends or sentiment following the update.

But what comes with Patch 4.1, you ask? Well, let's not faff about, and dive right into the patch notes with some juicy highlights:

- Tear down those walls and bolster your own with the latest settlements and sieges battle update.
- Mix things up on the fly with skill point resets.
- Projectiles find their way with Homing 2.0.
- Customize your main menu background with 19 additional themes.
- Stand sturdy with a massive suite of bug fixes, race tweaks, UI improvements, and more!

Check out the full 4.1 patch notes here!

As always, if you run into any bugs or issues after updating to 4.1, please report them over in our dedicated bug reporting forum.

answer: Player reactions to **Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1** showed a significant increase in positive sentiment. Review data from [T1] indicates that after the patch (split date: 2023-11-21), the positive review share rose from **41.41% to 73.75%** (difference: **+32.35%**, p-value: **0.0**), reflecting strong approval. Complaints about **bugs** dropped sharply from **23.24% to 4.58%** (p-value: **0.0**), and **price** complaints fell from **35.04% to 15.65%** (p-value: **0.0003**), suggesting improvements in stability and perceived value. However, **performance** complaints increased slightly (from 0.84% to 2.24%), though this was not statistically significant (p-value: **0.2906**). The patch notes [1] highlighted bug fixes, UI improvements, and balance adjustments, aligning with the observed sentiment shift.

documents.text: I've played extensively until May 2023. So i don't know the state of the game with the recent update. But one feeling remains : New World could have been great if it wasn't for the devs sheer incompetence and lack of care/respect for their community. So I'm not getting back into it nor do i care to know what's happenning. I hope some people can find enjoyment but New World will always be the gem that has been spoiled by the team behind it and there's no undoing those last 2 years.

“New World has made many changes that mean picking up the game after launch isn’t overly daunting,” Jayoddity said. “The levelling process has been sped up, which means you will catch up in no time and have fun doing so. There are many positive changes in the expansion that also improve endgame content and make New World a good option for all MMO players.”

WILL RETURNING PLAYERS HAVE VIABLE GEAR

https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1dA2shPbyqSahsSBYrfqpD/3bf7bf6304278e402acd4c749c7a1b6a/NW_BloodStainedSkin_MSQ_S2Announce_1920x1080_Final_CT-001711.jpg
“New World is about to be updated with its first expansion,” Jayoddity said. “All players are going to be searching for new equipment and joining that journey is part of the most fun you can have in MMOs. This type of vertical progression has rarely happened in New World. Gear that you acquired in the game’s early release has been theoretically very usable up until the expansion. The only changes would be if the meta changed or you wanted to try a new build. The expansion functions somewhat like a soft reset but that is what creates the most fun experiences.”

documents.text: So New World Aeternum just got released, all it feels like is an re release of the same game with some tweaks.The last big thing we got to New world, was Rise of the Angry Earth, which released in October 3d 2023, ofc we got some minor seasons, with small content within.....The only new things are:Swimming and cut-scenes when you speak with a character.Graphics are worse than before.And somehow, New world should also have "new servers" where your old max level character should be on a legacy server, which they ain'tTLDR: its just a huge mess, and a huge let down, for everyone who still had little hope.I can't recommend this, and I really hope they will learn from this (they won't)

answer: After Update 2.0.1 in July 2023, New World's reviews showed a statistically significant decline in positive sentiment. The review trend tool (T1) found that the positive share dropped from 0.5255 (before July 2023) to 0.4214 (after July 2023), a difference of -0.1041, with a p-value of 1.96×10⁻¹⁴ [T1]. This indicates a significant decrease in positive reviews post-update. The review sentiment tool (T2) also noted a smaller decline (diff: -0.0807, p=0.2265), though not statistically significant, likely due to sampling differences. Sources [1] and [5] corroborate ongoing criticism of the game’s development and content quality.
